name: AHT20
description: Calibrated digital temperature and humidity sensor with I2C interface.

pins.name: VDD
pins.notes: 2.2–5.5 V; add 10 µF decoupling cap between VDD and GND

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: Requires external 2.0–4.7 kΩ pull-up to VDD

pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: Requires external 2.0–4.7 kΩ pull-up to VDD

notes: Fixed I2C address 0x38 (not configurable). Power on then wait ≥100 ms before first command. After sending measurement command 0xAC, wait ≥80 ms before reading. Datasheet recommends ≥1 s between measurements to avoid self-heating. Add 10 µF decoupling capacitor close to VDD/GND pins. Use 2.0–4.7 kΩ pull-up resistors on SCL and SDA.
